summary: Wheel suspension/tire state initializer. For wheel index a2 on 'this', computes the wheel offset vector as a3 minus the chassis local origin (this[18], this[19], this[20] at offsets 0x48, 0x4C, 0x50), stores it into two per-wheel blocks (base this[74*a2+82], and relative +184/+188/+192 within the wheel state), then writes the suspension parameters a4, a5, a6 (e.g. +252, +248, +200, +196, +204), builds a 3x3 rotation matrix from Euler angles a5/a6 via F_33RotationMatrixFromEulerAngles (0x5670D0), copies a 0x24-byte block from this[74*a2+105] into the wheel state, and returns RotationMatrixYAxisRotationEulerExtraction(a4, wheel_state+128) (0x567340). Called by SuspensionAndWheelPhysics (0x4E5F60).

operations.description: Compute the wheel state base pointer: this[74 * a2 + 53] (element index 53 within the per-wheel stride of 74 floats).
Compute the wheel offset from the chassis local origin: v11 = *a3 - this[18], v12 = a3[1] - this[19], v13 = a3[2] - this[20], reading origin fields at offsets 0x48, 0x4C, 0x50.
Store the computed offset vector into the first per-wheel block at this[74 * a2 + 82] (three consecutive floats).
Store the same offset vector into the wheel state block at relative +184/+188/+192.
Store suspension parameters into the wheel state block: a4 at +252, a5 at +248 and +200.
Zero the DWORD at relative +196 and store a6 at relative +204 within the wheel state block.
F_33RotationMatrixFromEulerAngles(a5, a6) builds the 3x3 rotation matrix from the supplied Euler angles.
Copy a 0x24-byte block from this[74 * a2 + 105] into the wheel state at relative +140 (qmemcpy).
RotationMatrixYAxisRotationEulerExtraction(a4, wheel_state + 128) extracts the Y-axis rotation Euler angle for steering orientation.
